customManagers.description: A release asset's tag and sha256 on one ARG line under a `# renovate-digest:` comment: Renovate bumps the tag and takes the new sha256 from the new release's assets

packageRules.description: Wait before proposing a release, so most malicious ones are yanked before they reach a PR
One PR for pin and digest bumps, except the credential broker's (holds the real tokens) and the egress proxy's images: each of their bumps, digests too, gets its own PR
Majors need a data migration; move with production instead
